description: React component for a modal dialog that allows users to save dashboards, either overwriting existing ones or creating new copies, with options for naming and duplicating charts.

classes.name: SaveModal
classes.description: React functional component for dashboard save modal with options for overwrite or save as new dashboard.

methods.name: SaveModal
methods.description: Main function component handling dashboard save modal logic, state, and rendering.

methods.name: saveDashboard
methods.description: Handles the save action, constructs data payload, and triggers onSave callback.

methods.name: toggleDuplicateSlices
methods.description: Toggles the duplicate slices checkbox state.

methods.name: handleSaveTypeChange
methods.description: Updates saveType state based on radio button selection.

methods.name: handleNameChange
methods.description: Updates dashboard name and sets saveType to new dashboard.
